text: Done in b50a9da. PublicJson.provenance + release route: provenance {kind (kebab ActivityKind), reason, proposedBy, proposedAt, acceptedBy, changesFromParent {added|changed|removed: {count, paths<=200}}} only when catalog.check(ctx, dataset, ReadMetadata) passes dataset-wide; fixed-release grants get null. No kernel or Postgres changes were needed: Release already carries activity and acceptedBy. Deviation: candidate id is not included (Release does not carry it; the acceptance receipt has it). Corrected paths come from changesFromParent rather than an activity field. Cost: one extra parent release load per steward GET. Tests: ConsoleSuite assertProvenance (native-import, metadata-correction, reason, proposer/acceptor, added newSidecar, no digests/source); HttpSuite fixed-release null vs owner present. http/test 5/5, integration 9/9.
